newsitem.title: HONG KONG: VTech signs US$62.6 mln in loans.
newsitem.headline: VTech signs US$62.6 mln in loans.

text.p: VTech Holdings Ltd has signed agreements for a total of US$62.6 million in unsecured long-term loans with international banks, the company said Thursday.
The loans have an average term of three to five years, the company said. The interest rate on the five-year loan is 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, it said.
Proceeds are to be used for general working capital and an expansion plan.
Lenders are Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corp, Hang Seng Bank, Bank of East Asia, Standard Chartered Bank, Commerzbank, DG Bank and Banco Santander.
VTech noted that it received US$23.25 million from the expiry of warrants on September 30.

With the conclusion of these recent financial transactions and a cost-effective integrated line of operations in place, the company has has no immediate need to raise funds from the stock market, VTech said.
